common.integer_json: bigint/numeric are decimal strings at JSON/TS boundaries

common.ordinary_selection: available_at ASC, arrival_sequence ASC, SKIP LOCKED; no event targeting; unresolved routing holds the same task lease until attach authority or defer

common.claim_core: claim and reclaim_expired share the identical due queued/retry_wait/expired-processing candidate union and ordering; maintenance entry point cannot prioritize expired work or target an event
common.lock_order: canonical task/attempt then account/domain authority then price/projection rows sorted by natural key then audit; no provider calls while transaction locks held
common.phase2_write_scope: billing_v2 only, shadow candidates/audit; no schema exposes Pro to UI; prepare_checkout/record_checkout/handover return blocked without mutation
